coverageNotes: Does not test channel existence validation or frontend hook integration.

questions.concept: Scope the indexed range before pagination
questions.question: Which handler body applies that range before pagination?

options.rationale: Correct: equality on channelId scopes the native index before descending creation ordering within the channel and pagination.
Incorrect: this paginates the entire index first. Other channels consume page positions before the JavaScript filter removes them.
Incorrect: withIndex belongs to QueryInitializer; a Query produced by filter no longer provides it.
Incorrect: by_channel begins with channelId, not _id. A channel document ID belongs in the message channelId field.
